_why: The words of the INTERIM playable site: Legal's ruling RL-136 (docs/legal/photosensitivity-note.md, addendum 8; Orb's word 2026-10-14; seven days). Used only when tools/site.json has an "interim" block. tools/site-interim.mjs renders them as the click-through gate of /play/ and the About page; /, /bench/, /band/ and /404.html are the holding page (tools/site-notice.json), which is where "Not now" goes. tools/check-site-interim.mjs checks them. "draft": true is this file's own refusal: while it is true the build will not produce an interim site. The gate's words are Legal's, verbatim; change them only on Legal's word. Wording rules: never "safe", "seizure-safe", "tested for photosensitivity", "WCAG compliant" or "certified"; no "no flashing". "privacy_target" is the feedback target (ui/data/send.json _target) the privacy line was written for: the check fails if the build's target is another.

about.heading: About this build, licences and privacy

blocks.p: Orb Combat EX is a one-person project. Orb directs it, and AI tools write the code and draft the art, animation, dialogue and design documents. Nothing in the game is generated by AI while you play: the fight director and the world are ordinary game code.

This game collects and sends no personal data. The web version is hosted on GitHub Pages, which keeps its own server logs. The feedback button copies a report to your clipboard for you to paste to Orb; nothing is sent by the game.

This game contains flashing effects, and our own automated check found scenes that reach the recommended limit of three flashes a second, and a few that go over it on stricter readings. We are fixing them, and no independent analyser has been run. If you or someone in your family has photosensitive epilepsy, please do not play this version. Reduce flashing is on by default. It lowers some effects but does not remove the flagged scenes.
